# Political Science (BA)

---

Department majors are required to take ten courses (40 units) in political science.
In addition, one of the Honors Seminars (4 units of POSC 391 /POSC 392 ) can count as an elective.

sections.title: Elective Requirement

notes.text: Students must complete four additional elective courses, two of which must be upper division (300 or 400 level courses). One course (or four units) of the following courses: POSC 395 , POSC 398L or POSC 490x may be counted as an elective. In addition, one of the Honors Seminars (4 units of POSC 391 /POSC 392 ) can count as an elective.
notes.source_line: Students must complete four additional elective courses, two of which must be upper division (300 or 400 level courses). One course (or four units) of the following courses: POSC 395 , POSC 398L or POSC 490x may be counted as an elective. In addition, one of the Honors Seminars (4 units of POSC 391 /POSC 392 ) can count as an elective.

notes.text: Students who have a double major in political science and in another department in the social sciences, may, with prior permission of the department undergraduate adviser, substitute one upper-division course from the second major for one upper-division political science course. In the development of an undergraduate program, students should consult periodically with the political science undergraduate adviser and/or with departmental faculty.
